disputes.reason: Ambiguous: as written, 'whether the information pertains to senior management' could reasonably be argued as a valid implementation check (reports reaching senior management); falsity depends on the omitted 'restricting to senior management only' point.

Correction states 'at least 20 to 30 scenarios' without the mid-size-firm qualifier; the guideline is firm-size dependent (small firms may produce fewer, per the bank's own Q71), so the correction and explanation overgeneralise.

Defensible as partly true: Monte Carlo simulation does produce estimates of loss magnitude/frequency (the loss distribution); statement is ambiguous about 'estimate' versus input, so a candidate could reasonably argue it true.
